sources.title: AI Model Detector — Which AI Made This Image? | PromptShotAI
sources.snippet: Free AI model detector. Upload any image and find out which AI generated it — Midjourney, Flux, SDXL, DALL-E, or Ideogram — with a confidence score and visual tells.

sources.title: AI Model Detector: Which Model Wrote This Text? - TheChecker.AI
sources.snippet: TheChecker.AI identifies which of 40+ AI models likely produced a text — not just that it is AI. Per-model pages for GPT-5, Claude, Gemini, Llama and Mistral.

sources.title: Free AI Content Checker - Detect AI-Generated Text Instantly ...
sources.snippet: Check if your text was written by AI. Our free AI detection tool analyzes sentence structure, perplexity, and burstiness to identify AI-generated content before you submit.

sources.title: ModelGuessr - Guess the model
sources.snippet: Chat with a random AI model and see if you can identify which one it is from its replies.

sources.title: AI Text Detector | ReverseToolkit
sources.snippet: The AI Text Detector is an advanced analysis utility that uses machine learning to determine whether a piece of text was likely written by a human or generated by an AI model like ChatGPT or Claude. In an age of automated content, this tool provides a necessary layer of verification for educators, editors, and researchers.
